newsitem.title: USA: Sallie Mae special meeting delayed to June 5.
newsitem.headline: Sallie Mae special meeting delayed to June 5.

text.p: The Student Loan Marketing Association, Sallie Mae, said Thursday that it has adjourned the special shareholders meeting called to consider privatizing the company until June 5.
The company said that the action was taken to permit directors to make revisions to the privatization plan and to afford shareholders the chance to consider those revisions.
Sallie Mae said that shareholders may cast votes or change votes already cast until the polls are closed when the meeting reconvenes.

Neither management's privatization plan nor an alternative proposal by a group of shareholders, the Committee to Restore Value, has achieved the majority of shares outstanding required by the Sallie Mae Reorganization Act said the company's chief executive officer, Lawrence Hough.

"We will develop revisions to our plan that will address shareholder concerns about board control and board representation," he said. "We feel a considerable sense of urgency about bringing this matter to resolution."
